text: This staff report is about a matter that Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to prohibit parking at all times on the east side of Queen's Plate Drive, between Vice Regent Boulevard and Bethridge Road. This parking regulation amendment was at the request of the local Councillor, on behalf of the constituents of Queen's Plate Drive.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the east side of Queen's Plate Drive, between Vice Regent Boulevard and Bethridge Road.
